{{Quote|Well, Meatlump Wine is made from...well...I need you to go around the hideout and squash all the rodents you can find. Collect their juices and return them to me.|Chef Schlump|<ref name="SWG:WO" />}}
'''Meatlump wine''' was a type of [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Wine/Legends|wine]] made by the technology-hating [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization known as the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]]. The wine was made only from the finest ingredients, and was a favorite of the [[Meatlump King]]. [[Chef]] [[Schlump]] was known to direct the production of this wine, which was in fact made from [[meetle]]s and [[worrmp]]s crawling around the [[Meatlump Hideout]].<ref name="SWG:WO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meatlump wine was a beverage in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WO" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Meatlump wine was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
